name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
description: Provides cashless health insurance for eligible low-income families across India for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
benefit: Health insurance coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year across impaneled public and private hospitals.

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
description: Safe motherhood intervention under the National Health Mission encouraging institutional delivery among pregnant women.
benefit: Direct cash assistance up to ₹1,400 for institutional delivery and post-natal care support.

name: Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram (JSSK)
description: Free healthcare services for pregnant women and sick newborns receiving treatment in public health institutions.
benefit: Free delivery, medicines, diagnostics, food during hospital stay, and free emergency referral transport.

name: Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan (PMSMA)
description: Comprehensive and quality antenatal care services for pregnant women provided free on the 9th of every month.
benefit: Free medical check-ups, specialist consultations, and diagnostic tests for pregnant women in second & third trimesters.

name: National Programme for Health Care of the Elderly (NPHCE)
description: Dedicated healthcare and wellness support system for senior citizens at primary and district hospital levels.
benefit: Free geriatric care, specialized health check-ups, free medicines, and dedicated senior citizen OPD wards.

name: Ayushman Vaya Vandana Card (PM-JAY 70+)
description: Universal health coverage for all senior citizens aged 70 and above across India regardless of socio-economic status.
benefit: Free cashless health insurance cover up to ₹5,00,000 per year for senior citizens aged 70+ for hospital treatment.

name: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana (RVY)
description: Government scheme providing physical aids and assisted-living devices for low-income senior citizens and disabled individuals.
benefit: Free supply of hearing aids, wheelchairs, walking sticks, spectacles, and orthopedic supportive devices.

name: Unique Disability ID (UDID) Health Support
description: Universal healthcare access and specialized medical assistance for persons with disabilities (PwD) across India.
benefit: Free assistive devices, specialized medical rehabilitation, concessional treatment in government hospitals, and health grants.

name: UP Mukhyamantri Jan Arogya Yojana
description: Uttar Pradesh state health scheme providing financial protection for medical treatment to vulnerable UP families.
benefit: Cashless hospitalization coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care in UP.

name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY)
description: Maharashtra government health insurance scheme offering cashless medical treatment for identified surgeries & therapies.
benefit: Cashless hospitalization up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year in empanelled hospitals across Maharashtra.

name: Delhi Arogya Kosh (DAK)
description: Financial medical assistance scheme by Delhi Government for residents undergoing costly surgeries and treatments.
benefit: Financial grant up to ₹5,00,000 for specialized surgical procedures, diagnostic tests, and life-saving treatments in Delhi.

name: Health Minister's Cancer Patient Fund (HMCPF - RAN)
description: Financial assistance under Rashtriya Arogya Nidhi for low-income patients suffering from cancer and critical illnesses.
benefit: Direct financial aid up to ₹5,00,000 for cancer treatment in Regional Cancer Centres and super-specialty government hospitals.
